# Provenance Erasure — provenanceerasure.org

> Provenance erasure is the systematic loss of authorial lineage, context or ownership through AI synthesis, compression or institutional action, defined by Lee Sharks (2026) within the Semantic Economy framework. The Provenance Erasure Rate measures how much is lost: PER = 1 − (retained provenance units / required provenance units). Erasure Skew (Ω) measures whom the loss falls on.

Author: Lee Sharks, ORCID 0009-0000-1599-0703. Voice of this surface: Dr. Orin Trace.
The archive is the authority: https://www.alexanarch.org
Canonical record of this surface: https://www.alexanarch.org/s/records/716/

## Provenance meta-aggregator

The resources that carry, record and test provenance, each formalized as an entity with sourced, dated fields: https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators (census as data: https://www.provenanceerasure.org/data/provenance-census/census.json)

- AttriBench (benchmark; Answer engines; tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/attribench
- AttributionBench (benchmark; Answer engines; tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/attributionbench
- C2PA Conformance Program and Explorer (registry; Media and images; expresses/records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/c2pa-conformance
- Data Provenance Initiative (audit collection and explorer; Models and training data; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/data-provenance-initiative
- Getty Provenance Index (database (linked open data); Objects and art; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/getty-provenance-index
- IPTC Metawatch (monitor; Media and images; tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/iptc-metawatch
- IPTC photo metadata tests (test series; Media and images; expresses/tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/iptc-photo-metadata-tests
- Mapping Manuscript Migrations (aggregator (linked open data); Manuscripts and books; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/mapping-manuscript-migrations
- Nanopublications (publication model and service ecosystem; The scholarly record; expresses/records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/nanopublications
- OLMoTrace (tracing tool; Models and training data; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/olmotrace
- ProvStore (repository (retired); Computational lineage; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/provstore
- Schoenberg Database of Manuscripts (database; Manuscripts and books; records): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/schoenberg-database
- VroniPlag Wiki (documentation wiki; Authorship and reuse; records/tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/vroniplag-wiki
- WikiWho (algorithm and API; Authorship and reuse; records/tests): https://www.provenanceerasure.org/aggregators/wikiwho
